resources.name: Grok Bot 備份助理
resources.description: 直接匯入 Bot，它會引導你設定備份位置（Google Drive 或本機）與備份頻率；如果想自己安裝或修改，也可以查看 GitHub 開源程式。
resources.image_alt: AI 助理把文件和記憶備份到雲端與本機的插畫

resources.name: Grok Bot Backup Assistant
resources.description: Import the Bot and let it guide you through choosing where to store backups (Google Drive or locally) and how often to run them. The source code is available on GitHub if you prefer to set things up or customize them yourself.
resources.image_alt: An AI assistant backing up documents and memories to cloud and local storage

resources.name: Grok Bot 备份助手
resources.description: 直接导入 Bot，它会引导你设置备份保存位置（Google Drive 或本地）和备份频率。如果想自行部署或修改，也可以查看 GitHub 上的开源代码。
resources.image_alt: AI 助手将文档和记忆备份到云端与本地存储的插画
